gaps: Every breath-one member was written with the register standing at the list's gate, admitting a member the subject has (Can't-miss, Who fills the box), refusing one it has (No mark, No body, Reserved word, Named), or holding one that exists only while the register is spoken (Proviso, Admitted by a claimant, Only as a joke, Premise-carried member, Present tense for the unmade). Pressing on Cascade after the semicolon showed members that are the register's own recovery state, and pressing on the docket's numbered Does and the log's null line showed entries that are a slot's name; the register's apparatus had entered the list. This produced the changed question for breath two: which of a register's artifacts become members, and what happens to a manufactured member when the subject can read the register that made it.
accepted: Can't-miss: the register admits a member by the cost of leaving it off rather than by its likelihood, so the list holds items the subject almost never presents, as the emergency differential that lists aortic dissection and subarachnoid haemorrhage for a chest pain or a headache that is in all probability muscular, the pre-flight checklist that names the failure nobody on the line has seen, the pre-mortem that lists the way the launch dies; the register is the rule-out, written for a decision that must exclude before it can discharge, and its artifact is the entry that begins 'rule out'; the member is a real condition that the neutral list, ordered by frequency, would have cut in its second draft; the cost is the workup, the scan bought for a one-in-a-thousand, and the reader from outside who takes the list for a forecast; the tell that the register produced the placement, and not the subject, is that the item's position survives any change in the base rate and moves only when the harm of missing it changes; observed, in emergency medicine's must-not-miss lists and in aviation's normal checklists; not domain-entry-keys' Fatal class, which reads a domain's sorting of its errors, since here the sorting has been written into the list itself and the improbable member sits above the probable one; not Only as a joke, where the dangerous member is admitted because it cannot be said plainly, since here it is said plainly and first.

Who fills the box: the register decides whether the subject or an observer writes the entry, and a change of hand changes the membership with no change in the population, as the census that moved from enumerators assigning race at the door to householders marking their own box with the mail-in form of 1960, after which the count of American Indians rose across three decades faster than births could account for, and the 2000 form's 'mark one or more', which admitted several million people the single box could not hold; as the incident system that counts the injuries workers report against the ones the supervisor logs, the two lists differing by every case one hand would not write; the register is self-report against observation, and its artifact is the box and who holds the pencil; the member admitted is the identity or the event the observer's register refused; the cost is that the count now moves with what the subject is willing to say, so a change in the population and a change in the saying are the same line on the chart; the tell that the register produced the members is a discontinuity in the count at the date the hand changed, with no birth, death, or migration to explain it; observed; adds to witness-architectures' Room for strangers, a setting that lets private memories become recordable, the register that hands the pen to the remembered; not Admitted by a claimant, where a third party's claim is the membership, since here the subject speaks for itself.

No mark, no member: the register is written for telling members apart in the field, so it admits a member only with a mark that separates it from its nearest neighbour under field conditions, and refuses members the subject has but the field cannot resolve, as the bat guides that held one pipistrelle until hand-held detectors made the 45 and 55 kilohertz calls a mark any surveyor could use, whereupon the soprano pipistrelle, separate all along and formally described in 1999, entered the guides within the decade; as the mushroom guide that drops the species that keys only under a microscope, the bird guide that treats a cryptic pair as one until the song is written out; the register is identification, and its artifact is the confusion-species note, 'differs from the last by'; the member refused is the cryptic species, present in the fauna and absent from the list; the cost is a list of the distinguishable, not of the existing, and a survey that counts the guide rather than the wood; the tell that the register did it is that the list changes when the instruments change, a detector, a microscope, a recording, and not when the fauna does; observed; not No body, no name, where the member waits on evidence that it exists, since here existence is settled and the wait is for a difference a reader can use; adds to importance-detectors' Costly precision, where the finest measurement marks what matters, the coarsest field-usable one marking what the list can hold.

No body, no name: the register admits a member only with an artifact of its own evidentiary kind, so a member everyone has met is refused until the artifact exists, as the zoological code that names a species only on a name-bearing type, which left the kipunji, photographed in Tanzania in 2005 with no specimen taken, contested until a dead animal was recovered the next year, and left the Bulo Burti boubou of 1991, described from a bird that was released alive, disputed until it was shown to be a colour morph of a known species; as the dictionary on historical principles that admits a word only with a dated quotation in print, so that the spoken word waits years and the entry's first date is the printing's, not the word's; the register is the type requirement, and its artifact is the holotype in the drawer and the quotation slip; the member refused is the seen, heard, and used thing that has no artifact of the required kind; the cost is a list that lags the world by the time it takes to collect, and a list whose dates are the artifacts' dates, so that every antedating is the register confessing; the tell that the register refused it, rather than the subject lacking it, is that the member enters unchanged on the day the artifact arrives, with nothing about the animal or the word having changed; observed; adds to witness-architectures' Writable counterexample, where a refutation waits on a notation, the member that waits on a body; not No mark, no member, whose artifact is a difference from a neighbour rather than evidence of existence, since the kipunji was unmistakable and still refused.

Reserved word: the register withdraws an ordinary word from every member but one so that the one cannot be mistaken for any other, refusing members the subject plainly has, as the phraseology that after the 1977 Tenerife collision reserved 'takeoff' for the clearance itself and requires 'departure' everywhere else, the surgical count in which 'correct' is one thing and 'okay' is nothing, the fire ground's 'mayday' held for a firefighter in trouble and 'emergency' for everything else; the register is a controlled vocabulary written to be heard over noise by a tired listener, and its artifact is the phrasebook with its readback; the member refused is the natural sentence, 'we are now at takeoff', which was true on the runway that day and which the register had not yet refused; the cost is that speakers must be trained out of their own language and the list of sayable things is shorter than the list of true ones; the tell that the register did it is that the refused member is not wrong, only reserved, and re-enters the moment the protected member is not in play; observed; not Named, so the rest is refused, where the list refuses what it did not name, since here a named member is refused for a neighbour's sake; adds to register-jumps' Am I being detained?, a question that declares which register the room is in, the vocabulary that makes the declaration unnecessary by giving each critical member a word nothing else may use.

Named, so the rest is refused: the register reads any list as exhaustive, so the act of naming some members refuses every unnamed one, and a general word at the tail is read down to the kind of its neighbours, as the statute that lists 'automobiles, trucks, and other vehicles' and is held not to reach a bicycle, the lease whose enumerated permitted uses forbid the one the tenant forgot to write, the policy that names covered perils and thereby excludes the rest; the register is legal drafting under the canons that the expression of one excludes the other and that a tail is of the same kind as its neighbours, and its artifacts are the disclaimers drafters invented to escape them, 'including without limitation', 'by way of example only'; the member refused is the ordinary case the subject plainly has and the drafter plainly meant, unlisted because it was obvious; the cost is that every list becomes a fence and the tail must be written as carefully as the members, so that the same words in a neutral document are an illustration and in a contract a boundary; the tell that the register refused it is the disclaimer itself, a clause that exists only to stop a list from meaning what lists mean there; observed; adds to list-excellences' Negative space, where a list states what it refuses, the register in which a list refuses without stating it and must state when it does not; not Proviso, where a named exception depends on a named neighbour, since here the refused members are never named at all.

Proviso: the register admits a member as an exception to the member before it, so the list holds items that are nothing but a negation of their neighbour and cannot be read, moved, or kept without it, as the tax section that is one rule and eleven 'except as provided in', the criminal statute whose defence exists only as the carve-out from the offence, the insurance policy's exclusion and the exception to the exclusion; the register is legal drafting, in which a rule is stated whole and then cut back, and its artifact is 'provided that', with the interpretive rule that exceptions are read narrowly; the member is the exception; what it costs is a list that cannot be reordered, since each proviso must follow what it cuts, and a count inflated by items that are the negative image of other items; the tell that the register rather than the subject produced the item is that deleting the neighbour leaves the proviso meaningless, and that a flat restatement of the list merges it back into the rule it modifies; observed; adds to model-collapse-markers' Defenders becoming experts in the exceptions, which reads a framework's health off its exception count, the drafting register in which exceptions are the ordinary form of a member and no diagnosis follows; not Fence-forced defence, where the exception is written into an item to satisfy a frame, since the proviso is the frame's own honest cut.

Admitted by a claimant: the register may not assert, only attribute, so a member enters the list when someone can be cited as having said it, and membership becomes the existence of a claimant rather than the truth of a claim, as the encyclopedia written under a neutrality rule whose 'Criticism' and 'Controversies' sections list a company's faults by who complained, so that the loudest critic is a member and the uncontested defect that nobody wrote up is not, the news list of 'concerns' that consists of quotations, the literature review in which a finding is a member because a paper said so; the register is attribution, and its artifact is the phrase 'has been criticized for' with a footnote to the critic; the member is the claimed thing; the cost is that the list can be edited from outside by making claims, and that a defect with no advocate is refused however plain; the tell that the register rather than the subject produced the item is that the item's evidence is a person and not a case, and that it leaves the list when the citation dies rather than when the defect is fixed; observed; adds to witness-architectures' Deputized injury, where a tribunal registers a harm only through a person entitled to bring it, the neutral list in which anyone who published is entitled and the harm nobody brought is refused; not Who fills the box, where the subject speaks for itself.

Only as a joke: the register admits a member that cannot be said plainly in the room, so the list holds it in a form that cannot be restated flat without becoming an accusation, and the member is in the list for everyone who was there and absent from it for anyone who reads it later, as the risk that has a name only in the team's jokes, 'the Friday deploy', 'the patient who is a lawyer', the morbidity conference where the real cause is the laugh at the end, the retrospective whose one true item was said as a bit; the register is gallows, laughing at the abyss to keep working beside it, and its artifact is the running joke, which persists as a list member the way a proverb persists; the member admitted is the dangerous or shaming case the plain register refuses because a plain statement would have an author and an accused; the cost is that the member cannot be cited, cannot be handed to a successor who was not in the room, and does not appear in the written register of risks, so the list that is audited is missing exactly the item everyone knows; the tell that the register produced the form, and not the subject, is that the flat restatement is true and unsayable, so the item's truth survives translation and its membership does not; analytical, since every case is a room's and the item's absence from written lists is the mechanism; adds to register-jumps' The room's laugh, a claim made survivable by its delivery, the claim that then lives on a list only in that delivery; not Can't-miss, where the dangerous member is written first and plainly.

Premise-carried member: the register changes the world's rules so that a member can exist, and admits the member together with its premise, so the list holds distinctions the actual world does not instantiate and the reader must check whether the distinction survives the premise's removal, as Maxwell's demon, admitted to the list of ways to beat the second law by the premise of a being that can sort molecules, and surviving the premise's removal as the cost of erasing a record, as Galileo's chained falling bodies, admitted by an experiment never run and settling a real question, as the catalogue of animals that have just broken the flower vase, which survives nothing and was written to show that; the register is invented-world, declared, and its artifact is the premise clause, 'in a world where'; the member is the distinction the premise makes visible; the cost is a list with no denominator, since the world cannot be asked how many such members it has, and no refutation by case, only by rule; the tell that the register produced the item is that it has no observed instance and must say so, and past that, the sharper tell, that the distinction collapses when the premise is struck, in which case the member was the premise's and not the subject's; analytical, with observed thought experiments as cases, and no item on this map is itself invented-world; adds to this catalogue's own invented-world list of nonhuman intimacies the test its members owe; not Present tense for the unmade, where the world's rules are kept.

Present tense for the unmade: the register admits a member that has not been made, provided it is written in a grammar that marks it as unmade, so the list can hold what the subject does not yet contain and the tense is the only thing that says so, as the patent's prophetic example, which the examining manual permits so long as it is not written in the past tense, since the past tense asserts that an experiment was performed, and the patent office's 2021 notice that found readers, examiners among them, taking present-tense examples for results; as the claim that enumerates a genus of compounds by alternatives, most never synthesized, and the roadmap's feature written as if shipped; the register is the claim, which describes what is enabled rather than what was done, and its artifact is the tense rule; the member is the compound nobody has made; the cost is a list in which the made and the unmade sit in one column, so that a reader who does not know the tense rule cannot sort them and the register's tell is legible only to someone who knows it is a tell; the tell that the register produced the item is the present tense itself and, past that, the absence of any yield, melting point, or figure; observed, with a published estimate that a sizeable fraction of the examples in chemistry and biology patents are prophetic; adds to traces-of-the-unlived, where an alternative not taken changes the episode, the alternative entered on the list beside the taken ones in a tense that marks it; not Premise-carried member, where the world's rules are changed to make the member possible, since the prophetic example keeps the world and lacks only the experiment.

Nothing to report: the register obliges an entry per slot, a watch, a party, a field, so it manufactures a member for the slot the subject did not fill, and the manufactured member is either a zero or a variable, as the ship's log's 'nothing to report' written every watch of a quiet passage, the sentry's 'no change', the lab notebook's dated blank page signed as blank, and, on the docket, 'Does 1 through 10', numbered defendants nobody has identified, entered so that the suit can be filed before the names are known; the register is the mandatory entry, and its artifacts are the null line and the numbered blank; the members are entries whose content is that there is no entry; the cost is a list longer than its events, and a count that a reader from outside takes as ten defendants or a hundred incidents; what the two artifacts do differs, and the difference is the item's edge: the zero is a witness, it proves the watch was kept and the slot was looked at, and it is never replaced, while the variable is a promise, it holds a position for a member to come and is struck when the name is served or the suit ends; the tell that the register made it is that the item's content is the slot's name and nothing else; observed; adds to witness-architectures' Blindfolded tally, a witness built so that it cannot see, the entry that witnesses only that a witness was present; not Not elsewhere classified, where the manufactured member holds cases the others refused, since here it holds none.

Not elsewhere classified: the register obliges every case to be placed in some member, so it manufactures a residual member whose only content is refusal by the others, and that member grows as its neighbours are read strictly, as the diagnostic code's 'unspecified' entries, among the most used codes in any hospital's year, the census's 'Some Other Race', which in the 2020 count was, alone or in combination, the second-largest race group in the country, the patent classification's 'not otherwise provided for', the industry code's 'all other'; the register is closed placement, by coder, enumerator, or examiner, and its artifact is the residual code; the member is a category with no property, a bucket named by what it is not; the cost is a list whose largest member is its least informative one, and a count that reads as coverage when it is overflow; the tell that the register made it is that its name is the negation of its neighbours, that it has no case of its own, and that it grows whenever the named members are tightened and shrinks when a new named member is added, with no change in the population; observed; adds to form-yields' empty cell, the cell a form's failure leaves open, the overflowing cell the placement obligation fills; not Named, so the rest is refused, which refuses the unlisted, since here the unlisted is admitted under one name and the list pretends to be complete.

Cascade after the semicolon: the register must keep reporting after a member it cannot parse, so it invents a state to continue from and reads every following token against the invented state, manufacturing members that are consequences of one wrong member, as the compiler that prints forty errors for a missing semicolon, thirty-nine of which vanish when it is typed, the spell-checker that flags every word after an unclosed quotation, the linter that reports a hundred indentation errors for one tab, the audit that, having rejected one figure, rejects every total it feeds; the register is error recovery, written so that one run reports as much as it can, and its artifact is the recovery state, a guess at where the list would be if the first member had been right; the members are real complaints about an imagined text; the cost is a list whose length says nothing about the subject and whose reader must know to fix the first item and rerun; the tell that the register made them is that deleting or repairing one member removes many, which no member of the subject's own ever does; observed; adds to environment-loops' degenerate closure, where a reasoner reads its own rule back as evidence, the register that reads its own recovery back as the subject; not Slip read as a word, which stands alone and depends on no neighbour, since the cascade is nothing but dependence.

residue.item: Normative or nothing: the specification register admits only members with a compliance test, demoting the untestable to an informative note.
residue.why: Rejected: the MUST is a required part of the item, which fixes the unit and is item-grains' declared-modality grain; the refusal it makes is Named, so the rest is refused with a keyword, and no distinct tell was found.

residue.item: Praised into the list: the elegy register admits a retired member by its virtue and refuses the one that ended for cause.
residue.why: Rejected: admission by a value criterion is Can't-miss with the sign reversed, and no artifact or tell separated it; held as a case for the emotional-register question in the limits.

residue.item: Window, not cause: the adverse-event register admits everything in the window whether or not it was caused.
residue.why: Held for breath two: a real admission rule with a real artifact, the adverse-event table, but every case found was the precondition for a member the consent form wrote, and the item wants that member.

residue.item: Doe defendant: the docket manufactures a numbered blank to hold a party's slot.
residue.why: Merged into Nothing to report as the slot-filling rule's second artifact, a variable beside the null line's zero; one mechanism, an obliged entry, and the item now carries the difference between promise and witness as its edge.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real list is written under several registers at once, a legal one inside an operator's one inside an emotional one, and the map makes no claim to cover every register or every artifact.

The seriation is an itinerary of how the member stands to the register once the register is removed, not a ranking of the registers' honesty, usefulness, or frequency; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, passage, dependency, and incompatibility they draw are interpretations.

The illustrative cases (the Tenerife phraseology change, the kipunji and the Bulo Burti boubou, the pipistrelle split, the 1960 and 2000 census forms, the 2020 Some Other Race count, prophetic examples and the 2021 patent-office notice, 'dord') are simplified to expose one mechanism each; nomenclatural, drafting, and examining practice vary by code, jurisdiction, and office, and nothing here is legal or clinical advice.

What a grammatical frame does to the unit of an item ('phrased as a verb phrase', a required part, a count bound) is item-grains' and not a register; what a form imposed on the pile yields (an empty cell, an endpoint's limiting member) is form-yields'; what a verdict menu or a seat does to a critic's list is composition-yields'; and a live situation moved between registers is register-jumps'. This map holds what a register does to a list once the list is being written in it.

The emotional registers of this catalogue's own list ('ideonomy registers --ls') each assert an unlock; this map carries two of them as list mechanisms (gallows in Only as a joke, austerity as the refusing half of Named, so the rest is refused and Reserved word) and does not claim the other forty-six do anything to a list beyond tone.

gaps: The changed question yielded the register's apparatus as members, ordered by who reads it: a notation the register's own staff set in type (Slip read as a word), a frame the enumerator answered with a false clause (Fence-forced defence), a menu the subject answered with a symptom (Named into the placebo arm), and a trap a stranger built (Trap that took), which the first framing could not hold because it assumed a manufactured member stays caseless. The of-sentence now walks from members the register reached to members it made and the subject kept; the seriation's axis came from this, since the walk now ends where it began, at a member that survives the register's removal, and the difference between its two ends, found against made, is legible only from the register's own record. The consequential adjacency moved to Fence-forced defence and Named into the placebo arm, where the register's reader changes from its author to its subject.
accepted: Slip read as a word: the register's own working notation is admitted as a member, so the list holds an item that has no case outside the register's apparatus and its copies, as 'dord', which stood in the 1934 unabridged dictionary as a noun meaning density because a slip reading 'D or d', an abbreviations entry, was filed among the words and set in type, and was caught only in 1939 by an editor who missed its etymology; as the ghost word that enters a dictionary from a misprint in a source and is then quoted from the dictionary, the place-name that is a surveyor's annotation, the species that is a label's error; the register is the editorial apparatus, whose slips and labels share the list's grammar closely enough to pass, and its artifact is the notation itself; the member is an entry that was never a word; the cost is small per item and large in kind, since a list that can admit its own notation cannot be trusted to have refused it elsewhere; the tell that the register made it is that no case can be found outside the register's own files and the works that copied them, and that the item has no etymology, no first use, and no neighbour it depends on; observed; not Cascade after the semicolon, whose members fall together when one is fixed, since the slip stands alone; not Trap that took, which was manufactured on purpose to be found in copies, since the slip was found by accident and by its maker.

Fence-forced defence: the register's frame draws a fence, an of-sentence's clause that says what a member is not, and a member near the fence acquires a claim written to satisfy the fence rather than the case, so the list holds an item whose truest sentence is false, as the map of expiries in this atlas whose frame said 'without any party deciding about that option in particular', which put the bank holiday and the vesting ordinance outside it, whereupon the author wrote that the decree decides about the reserve and the exit dies as a side effect, a defence the fresh-context critic found false of a decree that forbids withdrawals by name, and the repairer rewrote the fence as 'no party at the holder's own table'; as the grant application whose aims are rewritten to the call's exclusions, the claim amended around the prior art until it claims the amendment; the register is the frame under which an author admits, and its artifact is the closing clause of an item, the 'not X, since', in which the fence is answered; the member is real and the clause is the register's; the cost is a false sentence carried by a true item, and a reader who trusts the item's own defence; the tell that the register produced the clause is that it appears only where the fence is near, answers the fence and not a neighbour, and that a reader who reads the fence and the case separately finds them disagree; observed, in this atlas's ledger of 2026-09-10, by role: author, fresh-context critic, repairer; adds to Proviso, the frame's honest cut, the dishonest cut written into the item because the frame would not be changed; not Present tense for the unmade, where the grammar marks what is unmade, since here the grammar marks nothing and the false clause reads as a fact.

Named into the placebo arm: the register requires that the subject be told what the list may contain before the list is made, so the subject produces the named members, and the list of what happened is the list of what was said, as the multicentre aspirin trial of the 1980s in which the centres whose consent form listed gastrointestinal effects had several times the withdrawals for gastrointestinal complaints, in both arms, of the centres whose form did not, as the placebo arm's adverse events generally, which track the leaflet more than the pharmacology, the survey whose listed options are the answers given, the incident category that fills once it is printed on the form; the register is informed consent, or any register that publishes its own menu to the subject, and its artifacts are the consent form and the adverse-event table in which everything in the window counts whether or not it was caused; the member is a real symptom, felt, that the subject would not have had, or would not have reported, under a register that did not name it; the cost is that the drug's list and the placebo's list share the members the form wrote, and the difference between arms is the only part of the list the subject did not produce; the tell that the register rather than the pharmacology produced the item is that the placebo arm's list matches the consent form and differs between sites by what the form said; observed; adds to environment-loops' loop through a user, the loop that runs before the output exists, since the subject read the menu first; not Trap that took, which was manufactured to be found and was taken by strangers, since here the manufacture was a duty of candour and was taken by the subject it protected.

Trap that took: the register manufactures a member on purpose so that copies of the list can be told from the list, and the manufactured member is then read by a subject who makes it true, as Agloe, New York, a town drawn on a 1930s road map from its makers' initials, copied by a rival, and then built, when a general store took the name from the map, so that the rival, challenged, could point to the store; as the fictitious biography in a 1975 encyclopedia and the fictitious word in a 2001 dictionary, found later in a rival's online list, and, on the largest scale and as an analytical claim in the literature, the census category written in 1980 to count a population that had not called itself by that name, which the population then adopted; the register is the copyright trap or the administrative category, and its artifact is the manufacturer's private list of what it made up; the member is the town, the word, the identity; the cost is that the register can no longer prove its own manufacture except from its private list, since the world now has a case; the tell that the register produced it is legible only before it took, as a member with no case and copies that match, and after it took the only tell is the manufacturer's own record; observed for the map, the encyclopedia, and the dictionary, analytical for the census; adds to narrative-feedbacks, where a narrative is validated by its target's reaction, the list member validated by being built; not Named into the placebo arm, where the subject was not meant to be caught and the manufacture was nobody's purpose.

residue.item: Window, not cause: the adverse-event register admits everything in the window whether or not it was caused.
residue.why: Merged into Named into the placebo arm as its precondition and second artifact, the adverse-event table; the window admits the member, the consent form writes it, and the tell belongs to the writing.

residue.item: Category that became a people: the 1980 census category adopted by the population it was written to count.
residue.why: Merged into Trap that took as its largest case and marked analytical; the mechanism, a manufactured member read by its subject and made true, is the same, and the census adds scale, not a carrier.

residue.item: Readback echo: the phraseology register obliges every clearance to be repeated, so the list of transmissions doubles with members whose content is their neighbour's.
residue.why: Rejected: the echo returns to the same speaker through the other party and is environment-loops' carrier; on this map it added a second case to Nothing to report without a tell of its own.

residue.item: Verdict attractor: the critique register's menu of four verdicts and its seat produced one verdict across thirty-eight critiques.
residue.why: Rejected: the menu is what a composition of passes does to a critic's list, which the fleet brief assigns to composition-yields; kept here only as a tell the critic of this map has been warned of.

Members the register made and the subject then kept (Named into the placebo arm, Trap that took) are in on the claim that the member is now the subject's, a symptom felt, a store standing, and the map does not claim the register's manufacture was thereby innocent or that the count can be corrected after the take; the census case in Trap that took is an analytical claim from the literature and is marked so.

neighbors.left: Cascade after the semicolon: the register must keep reporting after a member it cannot parse, so it invents a state to continue from and reads every following token against the invented state, manufacturing members that are consequences of one wrong member, as the compiler that prints forty errors for a missing semicolon, thirty-nine of which vanish when it is typed, the spell-checker that flags every word after an unclosed quotation, the linter that reports a hundred indentation errors for one tab, the audit that, having rejected one figure, rejects every total it feeds; the register is error recovery, written so that one run reports as much as it can, and its artifact is the recovery state, a guess at where the list would be if the first member had been right; the members are real complaints about an imagined text; the cost is a list whose length says nothing about the subject and whose reader must know to fix the first item and rerun; the tell that the register made them is that deleting or repairing one member removes many, which no member of the subject's own ever does; observed; adds to environment-loops' degenerate closure, where a reasoner reads its own rule back as evidence, the register that reads its own recovery back as the subject; not Slip read as a word, which stands alone and depends on no neighbour, since the cascade is nothing but dependence.
neighbors.right: Slip read as a word: the register's own working notation is admitted as a member, so the list holds an item that has no case outside the register's apparatus and its copies, as 'dord', which stood in the 1934 unabridged dictionary as a noun meaning density because a slip reading 'D or d', an abbreviations entry, was filed among the words and set in type, and was caught only in 1939 by an editor who missed its etymology; as the ghost word that enters a dictionary from a misprint in a source and is then quoted from the dictionary, the place-name that is a surveyor's annotation, the species that is a label's error; the register is the editorial apparatus, whose slips and labels share the list's grammar closely enough to pass, and its artifact is the notation itself; the member is an entry that was never a word; the cost is small per item and large in kind, since a list that can admit its own notation cannot be trusted to have refused it elsewhere; the tell that the register made it is that no case can be found outside the register's own files and the works that copied them, and that the item has no etymology, no first use, and no neighbour it depends on; observed; not Cascade after the semicolon, whose members fall together when one is fixed, since the slip stands alone; not Trap that took, which was manufactured on purpose to be found in copies, since the slip was found by accident and by its maker.
neighbors.separating_case: Two lists each hold one item that is the register's and not the subject's. A compiler prints forty errors for a source file; type the missing semicolon and thirty-nine vanish, so the thirty-nine were the recovery state's. A dictionary holds 'dord' from 1934 to 1939; delete the entries on either side of it and nothing about 'dord' changes, and no text outside the dictionary and the works that copied it has ever used the word. The first item falls with its neighbour; the second stands alone and has no case. The same deletion test that convicts the cascade acquits the slip, and the slip is convicted only by the search for a case outside the apparatus, which is why the two are one edge and not one item.

checks.boundary_case: The grammatical frame 'phrased as a verb phrase', under which this catalogue's list of mathematical moves is written, is the tempting nonmember: it plainly changes what the list can hold. Ruled out: it fixes the unit of an item and not who may write one, what counts as evidence, or what an entry must carry, so it is item-grains' and not a register's; with it go the seriation endpoint that demands its limiting member, which is form-yields', and a situation moved between registers, which is register-jumps'.
checks.form_inference: The map shows what the walk conceals. The walk places the apparatus members in one band by how they were made, but the edge from Named into the placebo arm to Trap that took states the condition under which any manufactured member outlives the register, that its subject can read it, so the fate of Cascade and Slip is fixed by their readership and not by the band they sit in, and a reader can infer that a register is safe to let manufacture exactly when its subjects cannot read the list, and that a list published to its subjects will meet its artifacts in the world. The fork from No body to No mark says two refusing registers over one fauna disagree by exactly the artifact-mismatched members, so a disagreement between two lists of one fauna is a fact about the registers and not the wood. The passage from Fence-forced defence to Proviso, observed in this atlas's own repair, says a proviso appearing in a frame after review marks where an item had been defending itself. The deletion test on the Cascade to Slip edge gives the enumerator a procedure the bare list did not.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each item names a distinct register, its artifact, the member, the cost, and the tell that the register produced it; the strange members, a town built from a trap and a symptom written by a consent form, are kept with their modality marked rather than replaced by respectable neighbours; the fresh-context critic's reading is pending.

next_crossfield_opening: Registers read by their subjects: connect Named into the placebo arm, Trap that took, and Who fills the box with narrative-feedbacks and with denominator-manufactures' declared refusal, and ask whether every list that its subjects can read manufactures members at the rate its subjects believe it, so that a census, a leaflet, a field guide handed to birders, or an atlas read by the model that will write its next map is a register whose artifacts must be expected in the next count; if that holds, the tell for a manufactured member in any subject-readable list is not a missing case but a case that appears after publication, and the atlas's own ledgers, which its authors read, are the first place to look.

gaps: Trap that took, the terminus of the walk, stated the copyright trap's purpose (telling copies from the list) as its mechanism while carrying the 1980 census category, manufactured for no such purpose, as its largest case; the mechanism the cases share is a member with no prior instance, manufactured on purpose, then instantiated by a reader who could read the register. The same fault sat on the other side of the closing edge: Named into the placebo arm separated itself by 'taken by strangers', false of the census case, and the separation that holds is whether the member occurred at any rate before the register named it (a gastrointestinal complaint did; Agloe and the category did not). The closing edge's inference, that readership fixes a manufactured member's fate, survives, so the fault was in the item's statement of its mechanism and not in the map's form. Next worst: Premise-carried member cited Galileo's falling bodies, which the map's own edge to Present tense for the unmade, sorting by whether anyone could be asked to run it, sends to the prophetic side.
accepted: No body, no name: the register admits a member only with an artifact of its own evidentiary kind, so a member everyone has met is refused until the artifact exists, as the zoological code that names a species only on a name-bearing type, which left the kipunji, described from photographs taken in Tanzania in 2005 with no specimen, contested until a dead animal was recovered later that year and given its own genus on that specimen in 2006, and left the Bulo Burti boubou of 1991, described from a bird that was released alive, disputed until it was shown to be a colour morph of a known species; as the dictionary on historical principles that admits a word only with a dated quotation in print, so that the spoken word waits years and the entry's first date is the printing's, not the word's; the register is the type requirement, and its artifact is the holotype in the drawer and the quotation slip; the member refused is the seen, heard, and used thing that has no artifact of the required kind; the cost is a list that lags the world by the time it takes to collect, and a list whose dates are the artifacts' dates, so that every antedating is the register confessing; the tell that the register refused it, rather than the subject lacking it, is that the member enters unchanged on the day the artifact arrives, with nothing about the animal or the word having changed; observed; adds to witness-architectures' Writable counterexample, where a refutation waits on a notation, the member that waits on a body; not No mark, no member, whose artifact is a difference from a neighbour rather than evidence of existence, since the kipunji was unmistakable and still refused.

Premise-carried member: the register changes the world's rules so that a member can exist, and admits the member together with its premise, so the list holds distinctions the actual world does not instantiate and the reader must check whether the distinction survives the premise's removal, as Maxwell's demon, admitted to the list of ways to beat the second law by the premise of a being that can sort molecules, and surviving the premise's removal as the cost of erasing a record, as the chase after a beam of light, admitted by the premise of an observer riding beside it, which the world's rules forbid anyone to be asked to do, and surviving the premise's removal as the muon that reaches the ground because its clock has run slow, as the catalogue of animals that have just broken the flower vase, which survives nothing and was written to show that; the register is invented-world, declared, and its artifact is the premise clause, 'in a world where'; the member is the distinction the premise makes visible; the cost is a list with no denominator, since the world cannot be asked how many such members it has, and no refutation by case, only by rule; the tell that the register produced the item is that it has no observed instance and must say so, and past that, the sharper tell, that the distinction collapses when the premise is struck, in which case the member was the premise's and not the subject's; analytical, with observed thought experiments as cases, and no item on this map is itself invented-world; adds to this catalogue's own invented-world list of nonhuman intimacies the test its members owe; not Present tense for the unmade, where the world's rules are kept.

Named into the placebo arm: the register requires that the subject be told what the list may contain before the list is made, so the subject produces the named members, and the list of what happened is the list of what was said, as the multicentre aspirin trial of the 1980s in which the centres whose consent form listed gastrointestinal effects had several times the withdrawals for gastrointestinal complaints, in both arms, of the centres whose form did not, as the placebo arm's adverse events generally, which track the leaflet more than the pharmacology, the survey whose listed options are the answers given, the incident category that fills once it is printed on the form; the register is informed consent, or any register that publishes its own menu to the subject, and its artifacts are the consent form and the adverse-event table in which everything in the window counts whether or not it was caused; the member is a real symptom, felt, that the subject would not have had, or would not have reported, under a register that did not name it; the cost is that the drug's list and the placebo's list share the members the form wrote, and the difference between arms is the only part of the list the subject did not produce; the tell that the register rather than the pharmacology produced the item is that the placebo arm's list matches the consent form and differs between sites by what the form said; observed; adds to environment-loops' loop through a user, the loop that runs before the output exists, since the subject read the menu first; not Trap that took, whose member had no instance at any rate before the register wrote it, since a gastrointestinal complaint occurs in a placebo arm at some base rate under any form and the consent form only raised it, so that striking the form leaves the member at its base rate where striking the map leaves no town.

Trap that took: the register manufactures on purpose a member that has no instance anywhere, and the manufactured member is then read by a subject who can read the register and makes it true, as Agloe, New York, a town drawn on a 1930s road map from its makers' initials so that copies of the map could be told from the map, copied by a rival, and then built, when a general store took the name from the map, so that the rival, challenged, could point to the store; as the fictitious biography in a 1975 encyclopedia and the fictitious word in a 2001 dictionary, found later in a rival's online list, and, on the largest scale and as an analytical claim in the literature, the census category written in 1980 to count a population that had not called itself by that name, which the population then adopted; the register is the copyright trap or the administrative category, and its artifact is the manufacturer's private list of what it made up; the member is the town, the word, the identity; the cost is that the register can no longer prove its own manufacture except from its private list, since the world now has a case; the tell that the register produced it is legible only before it took, as a member with no case and copies that match, and after it took the only tell is the manufacturer's own record; observed for the map, the encyclopedia, and the dictionary, analytical for the census; adds to narrative-feedbacks, where a narrative is validated by its target's reaction, the list member validated by being built; not Named into the placebo arm, whose member occurred at some base rate before the form named it and was only raised, since the town, the word, and the category had no bearer at any rate until the register was read.
limits: The census undercount is out: a real member of the population that the count lacks reads like a refusal, but no rule of who may write, what counts as evidence, or what an entry must carry refused anyone, and the count moves with the operation (follow-up, address lists, weather) and not with the rules, so it is a coverage failure belonging to a denominator's blind spot or a stall; the moment the Bureau changes who may answer for a household or what counts as a resident it becomes Who fills the box, and that is the line (critic's boundary case).
seed: A register whose tell is a distribution and not a case. Every tell on this map is per item: delete the neighbour, search for a case outside the apparatus, watch the count at the date the hand changed. The significance threshold is a register (what counts as evidence of a member is a p below a line) that does all three of the of's verbs at once, refusing true small effects, manufacturing false positives, reaching nothing the neutral register could not, and its tell is the bunching of reported values just under the line, readable only across a population of items and never from one. Asking which of the map's other registers has a distributional tell (the type requirement's rate of antedatings; the rule-out's ratio of scans to findings; the residual code's share of the year) would give the enumerator a second kind of test, and the atlas's own ledgers, where keep rates bunch at one, are the first population to read it on.
